repairs: Pass 1 blocking finding: synthesis Section 7 attributed the machine-verification results to formal/drafts/Proofs.lean and formal/drafts/Core.hs, which are draft paths excluded from the release. This was falsified directly: compiling formal/drafts/Core.hs under the exact policy the paper credits it with produced 9 errors under -Werror=x-partial, so the sentence 'It type-checks under -Wall with no warnings; all 21 checks pass' was false of the named file and true only of the shipped formal/haskell/Core.hs. Repointed both references to the shipped paths formal/lean/Proofs.lean and formal/haskell/Core.hs.

Pass 1 blocking finding: the declared output website/reviews/website-self-review.json was absent from the workspace. Created it as a byte-identical copy of reviews/website-self-review.json, deliberately without adding a new website link so that the 19/19 local-target count already recorded in receipts/website.json remains accurate.

Pass 2 blocking finding: the synthesis review's first blocking finding, the overloading of the symbol M to mean both a subset of a real vector space and a symmetric monoidal category, was only half repaired. Definition 2.1 had been renamed to the linear-model class L, but Definition 2.7, Assumption 3.1, Theorem 3.2 with its proof, and Corollary 3.5 still wrote M for that same linear class, so the closure hypothesis read m+K subset of M with M a category, reinstating the exact type error under a new name. Replaced those six occurrences with L, leaving M used exclusively for the symmetric monoidal system theory and L_X untouched as the Lie derivative.

Rebuilt papers/pdf/synthesis.pdf after each repair with a clean output directory, reconfirmed exit status 0, zero diagnostics and 10 pages, then updated the synthesis source_sha256 and pdf_sha256 in receipts/latex.json to the recomputed digests and re-synchronised papers/latex/synthesis.tex, papers/pdf/synthesis.pdf and receipts/latex.json into website/ so all copies remain byte-identical.
